articles.headline: Marvell’s Google AI Chip Deal Could Drive $120 Billion in Long-Term Revenue: Analyst
articles.summary: Rosenblatt and Needham both raised price forecasts on Marvell Technology (MRVL) to $300 following fiscal Q2 results and an upgraded revenue outlook driven by data center demand.

articles.headline: Marvell CEO Calls Google AI Revenue Opportunity a 'Monster Number'

articles.headline: EXCLUSIVE: Claude Revenue Surges 1,000% as Anthropic Gains on ChatGPT
articles.summary: Claude now earns 31 cents for every $1 ChatGPT makes on mobile, up from just 3 cents in January, as Anthropic rapidly closes the revenue gap.

articles.headline: Marvell Technology Stock Slides: Data Center Strength Overshadowed by Valuation Concerns
articles.summary: Marvell Technology stock fell nearly 8% premarket as clarification around its Google deal and rich valuations outweighed a strong Q2 earnings beat and raised outlook.

articles.headline: MRVL Stock Plunges 8% in Premarket After Double Beat — Time to Buy the Dip? Analyst Nicholas Mugalli Says 'A Trillion-Dollar Company It Is!'
articles.summary: MRVL plunged 9% despite a Q2 beat due to margin fears. Is it time to buy the dip? One analyst says Marvell is a "trillion dollar company!"
